text:
julia: FYI we're scheduling a focused image hardening push for staging tonight 23:00 UTC. Main goals: apply distro CVE patches, enforce seccomp/default profile, drop dangerous caps, and wire audit-forwarding to long-term logging. Need quick sign-offs on RBAC and signing approach.

omar: list the specific SA changes so I can update rolebindings and IAM sync. Also any clusterRole removals?

julia: New/changed SAs: image-baker-staging (remove cluster-admin), runtime-staging-sa (tighten to namespace-only), audit-forwarder-sa (fluentd sidecar), registry-puller-staging (readonly). We'll replace bake-runner cluster role with a namespaced Role.

li: KMS/signing question: use GCP KMS for cosign on staging (fast), or use Vault transit with HSM in our test cluster (more control)? Preference for staging is KMS to avoid extra latency.

omar: RBAC plan: I'll create a Role for bake-runner with just create/list/watch on pods, secrets:get for registry creds, and no cluster-level perms. For audit-forwarder-sa I'll only allow create events and write to the logging namespace.

infra-bot: Scheduled: image-hardening-staging-job at 2024-05-18T23:00:00Z (2h window).

natalie: Vulnerability note 11: base layer includes libcurl linked to an older libssl. CVE requires bumping distro packages; recommend rebuilding base and re-running scanners.

li: For staging signing I'm fine with GCP KMS: projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/staging-key. We can use cosign with --kms. After successful push we can run a controlled rotation if needed.

julia: Pipeline gating: bake -> sbom -> vuln-scan -> policy-check -> sign -> push. If vuln-scan reports any HIGH/CRITICAL, pipeline should fail and create an incident. sec-oncall should be paged.

omar: Admission policy updates: I'll push a Gatekeeper constraint to drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_NET_RAW, and set seccomp to runtime/default for all runtime images. Also will add a mutation to set readOnlyRootFilesystem=true where possible.

li: Audit forwarding: we must redact secrets and tokens before shipping. Proposed FluentD snippet to redact envs: 

```
<filter kubernetes.**>
  @type record_transformer
  enable_ruby true
  <record>
    env_vars "[REDACTED]"
    kube_token "[REDACTED]"
  </record>
</filter>
```

natalie: Make sure audit metadata includes image_digest and cosign_signature annotations so we can trace provenance back when triaging.

julia: Rollout strategy: 10% canary for 10 minutes, monitor error rate and latency. If error rate > 4% sustained for 5m, auto-rollback to previous pinned tag. Keep previous tag pinned for quick revert.

omar: Who can rotate the staging signing key? I need a small list to give IAM on KMS.

li: I + one ops lead (sam) have staging key rotate permissions. I can sign but not rotate. After successful push I'll coordinate rotation with sam.

infra-bot: Runbook update: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/image-hardening (added canary checklist and rollback playbook).

sec-oncall: I'll be on-call during the window. If vuln-scan fails with criticals, page me and we'll open an incident bridge.

natalie: I'll add an automated blocker in CI that fails the merge and leaves a commented triage checklist when high CVEs detected.

julia: Short checklist for tonight:
- rebuild base with patched packages (libssl/libcurl)
- bake SBOM and upload to artifact-store
- run vuln scanner and fail on high/critical
- enforce Gatekeeper policies (caps/seccomp/rofs)
- deploy audit-forwarder DaemonSet with redaction filters
- sign images with cosign + KMS (staging key)
- deploy 10% canary, monitor, then promote

omar: ack 14:00. I'll send the rolebinding diffs to the infra repo and open a PR for review.

li: ack 14:01. I will not touch prod keys.

natalie: ack 14:02. I'll push the scanner gate to CI tonight and validate on a smoke build.

infra-bot: Reminder: maintenance starts in ~11 hours.

julia: Thanks everyone. Ping here if anything blocks. Closing thread for now.
